JavaScript runs one task at a time, while the browser coordinates other work.

00:00:06.200 --> 00:00:13.600
Function calls enter the call stack. The newest call completes first, then control returns to the function below it.

3
00:00:14.200 --> 00:00:23.600
When the current task finishes, the browser drains microtasks before running the next task, such as a ready timer callback.

4
00:00:24.200 --> 00:00:29.600
Remember the order: finish the task, drain microtasks, then take the next task.
